body:
## Sector P full-payment price schedule

Compare the Sector P / The Caladan prices effective 02 November 2026. The listed discounted price with plot number starts at PKR 41.90 Lac for 5.56 Marla. Ask for the exact plot number and final quotation.

## Sector P plan and plot position

Use the official Sector P plan to compare plot location, road width and nearby open areas. Request an available plot number marked on the plan before shortlisting.

## Included costs and location premiums

Development charges are included in plot price. The price plan lists PKR 20,000 registration. Some preferred locations may have additional premiums; ask for an itemized quotation for your selected plot.

## Compare available sizes

The price schedule lists 5.56 Marla, 8 Marla, 10.89 Marla, 14.22 Marla, 1 Kanal and two 2 Kanal plot dimensions. Share your budget and preferred size for current availability and location guidance.
